review.schema.advance.advance: The target range and its attribution. advance.target must equal the clean worktree HEAD.
review.schema.advance.advance.deliveries: Map of commit SHA to a member task ID. Keys are commits in previous_target..target that belong to this batch. At least one is required.
review.schema.advance.advance.foreign_co: Optional map of the other commit SHAs in that range to a non-empty reason. Every commit in the range appears in exactly one of deliveries and foreign_commits.
review.schema.advance.advance.previous_t: Current batch target. It must be an ancestor of advance.target.
review.schema.advance.advance.reason: Non-empty reason for moving the target.
review.schema.advance.advance.target: New batch target. A full commit SHA, not a timestamp. It must equal the clean worktree HEAD.
review.schema.advance.expected_revision: Current batch revision. The command rejects a stale value.
review.schema.assign.author: Non-empty name of the caller making the assignment.
review.schema.assign.batch_id: Batch ID. It must equal that run's batch.
review.schema.assign.items: Map of finding ID to task ID arrays. The keys are exactly the finding IDs in the report, not assignee names. Every listed task ID must be a member of the run.
review.schema.assign.owners: Ignored. The command sets each task ID to that card's OWNER.
review.schema.assign.recorded_at: Ignored. The command sets the UTC timestamp.
review.schema.assign.run_id: Run ID of the successful review run being assigned.
review.schema.close.author: Non-empty name of the caller closing the batch.
review.schema.close.mechanical: One object for each fixed must-fix disposition whose mechanical field is set. Omit the array when there is none.
review.schema.close.mechanical.item.auth: Required on each mechanical entry. It must equal the close request author.
review.schema.close.mechanical.item.basi: Required on each mechanical entry. Non-empty independent classification basis.
review.schema.close.mechanical.item.cate: Required on each mechanical entry. It must equal the disposition's mechanical value.
review.schema.close.mechanical.item.diff: Required on each mechanical entry. 64 lowercase hex SHA-256 of the stdout of: git diff --no-ext-diff --no-textconv --no-renames --binary --full-index --no-color RUN FIX -- :(literal)PATH. PATH is each path in paths. RUN is the run commit and FIX is fix_commit.
review.schema.close.mechanical.item.fact: Required on each mechanical entry. Non-empty facts that show the change stays inside that category.
review.schema.close.mechanical.item.find: Required on each mechanical entry. The finding this assessment covers.
Required on each mechanical entry. Finding ID.
Required on each mechanical entry. Run ID of the finding.
review.schema.close.mechanical.item.fix_: Required on each mechanical entry. The same fix_commit as the disposition.
review.schema.close.mechanical.item.path: Required on each mechanical entry. Sorted unique repository-relative paths. They must be exactly the files changed from the run commit to fix_commit. No absolute path, empty name, or .. .
review.schema.close.mechanical.item.reco: Required on each mechanical entry. record_id of that disposition.
review.schema.close.mechanical.item.repo: Required on each mechanical entry. The same report_hash as the disposition.
Required on each mechanical entry. The reviewer's mechanical label, or an empty string when the reviewer omitted it.
review.schema.close.mechanical.item.task: Required on each mechanical entry. Task ID on that disposition.
review.schema.close.opinions: Optional notes from the closing caller. They do not replace author dispositions. Omit the array or send an empty array when there are none.
review.schema.close.opinions.item.author: Required on each opinion. Non-empty name of the note's author.
review.schema.close.opinions.item.basis: Required on each opinion. Non-empty basis.
review.schema.close.opinions.item.findin: Optional. When present, the finding must exist on that run.
Required when finding is present. Finding ID.
Required when finding is present. Run ID of the referenced finding.
review.schema.close.resolved_failures: Map of a failed run ID to the successful replacement run ID. Send an empty object when the role has no failed run. Every failed run of a required role must appear.
review.schema.close.roles: One entry for each required role. Do not include a role whose requirement is N/A.
review.schema.close.roles.key.basis: Required on each role entry. Non-empty basis for accepting that conclusion.
review.schema.close.roles.key.passed_at: Required on each role entry. A 40 or 64 character lowercase hex commit, not a timestamp. Use the run commit, or the mechanical fix commit when every remaining must-fix fixed in that same run has a mechanical assessment.
review.schema.close.roles.key.run_id: Required on each role entry. Run ID of that role's successful conclusion. The run's execution status must be ok, and it must not be an older run replaced by a later one.
review.schema.close.view_hash: Lowercase SHA-256 of the exact bytes printed by review aggregate for this batch.
review.schema.disposition.author: Current card OWNER. When submitted_revision is omitted, author must equal the assignment owner of task_id. A later owner appends a new record.
review.schema.disposition.authorization: Send this only when the card is bound to a dispatch. dispatch_id and epoch must then match the active grant.
Required when authorization is present. Dispatch ID of the active execution grant.
Required when authorization is present. Epoch of that grant.
review.schema.disposition.basis: Non-empty factual basis for this status.
review.schema.disposition.batch_id: Batch ID. It must equal the run's batch.
review.schema.disposition.finding_id: Finding ID from the report. It must name that finding.
review.schema.disposition.fix_commit: Required when status is fixed, and forbidden otherwise. A 40 or 64 character lowercase hex commit later than the reviewed commit. Not a timestamp.
review.schema.disposition.mechanical: Allowed only when status is fixed. A same-run must-fix can advance passed_at only when this is set and close.mechanical repeats the evidence. Omit it otherwise.
review.schema.disposition.original: The finding text, copied verbatim. It is not a summary.
review.schema.disposition.previous_recor: Set when this record replaces an earlier disposition of the same finding and task. Omit it on the first record.
review.schema.disposition.record_id: New disposition ID. Same spelling rule as plan_id.
review.schema.disposition.recorded_at: Ignored. The command sets the UTC timestamp.
review.schema.disposition.report_hash: Lowercase SHA-256 of the run's report.md bytes.
review.schema.disposition.run_id: Run ID. It must equal the review run.
review.schema.disposition.status: confirmed and unverifiable apply only to must-fix tiers and block closure. deferred applies only to non-blocking tiers. waived applies only to Security. fixed also requires fix_commit and verification.
review.schema.disposition.submitted_revi: Ignored on a new record. The command stores the card revision. A resubmit of the same bytes keeps the stored value.
review.schema.disposition.task_id: Task ID that the assignment lists for this finding.
review.schema.disposition.verification: Required when status is fixed, and forbidden otherwise. The command, inspection, or comparison that showed the fix.
review.schema.disposition.waiver: Required when status is waived, and forbidden otherwise.
review.schema.disposition.waiver.decisio: Required when waiver is present. The user decision, or the timeout notice basis. Non-empty.
review.schema.disposition.waiver.policy: Required when waiver is present. accepted-risk records a user decision. timed-out also requires sent_at and timeout_at.
review.schema.disposition.waiver.sent_at: Required when policy is timed-out. RFC3339Nano timestamp of the notice.
review.schema.disposition.waiver.timeout: Required when policy is timed-out. RFC3339Nano, at least 15 minutes after sent_at, and not in the future.
review.schema.extend-plan.author: Non-empty name of the caller.
review.schema.extend-plan.batch: One batch to append. Omit it when only sealing or rebinding. Sending batch or seal is mutually exclusive with rebind_cycles and with sync_targets. This object does not accept cwd or report_language.
review.schema.extend-plan.batch.base: Required when batch is present. A full commit SHA, or N/A when every role is N/A. A following batch uses the previous closed target.
review.schema.extend-plan.batch.batch_id: Required when batch is present. Batch ID, same spelling rule as plan_id. It must be new to the plan.
review.schema.extend-plan.batch.previous: Required when batch is present. It must be the batch_id of the plan's current last batch.
review.schema.extend-plan.batch.requirem: Required when batch is present. Exactly PMQA and Security. Each value is required, or N/A: followed by a non-empty reason.
review.schema.extend-plan.batch.target_c: Required when batch is present. A full commit SHA, or N/A when every role is N/A. Not a timestamp.
review.schema.extend-plan.batch.task_ids: Required when batch is present. Task IDs in the new batch. Each one must already be a plan member.
review.schema.extend-plan.expected_revis: Current plan revision. The command rejects a stale value.
review.schema.extend-plan.rebind_cycles: Map of task ID to the cycle digest from review progress. It must name exactly the members whose cycle changed. Mutually exclusive with sync_targets and with batch or seal.
review.schema.extend-plan.seal: When true, every plan member must already belong to a batch. May be sent together with batch. Mutually exclusive with rebind_cycles and with sync_targets.
review.schema.extend-plan.sync_targets: Map of batch ID to that batch's current target commit. The value must equal the runtime batch target, and the plan copy must still differ. Mutually exclusive with rebind_cycles and with batch or seal.
review.schema.plan.author: Non-empty name of the caller creating the plan.
review.schema.plan.basis: Non-empty reason this plan is the execution review plan.
review.schema.plan.batches: Ordered batches. The first batch omits previous_batch_id. Each later batch's previous_batch_id is the preceding batch_id.
review.schema.plan.batches.item.base: Review base. A 40 or 64 character lowercase hex commit, or N/A when every role in requirements is N/A.
review.schema.plan.batches.item.batch_id: Batch ID, using the same spelling rule as plan_id.
review.schema.plan.batches.item.previous: Empty on the first batch. On every later batch, the previous batch's batch_id.
review.schema.plan.batches.item.requirem: Exactly the keys PMQA and Security. Each value is required, or N/A: followed by a non-empty reason.
review.schema.plan.batches.item.target_c: Commit this batch reviews. A 40 or 64 character lowercase hex commit, not a timestamp, or N/A when every role is N/A.
review.schema.plan.batches.item.task_ids: Task IDs covered by this batch. Each one must be a plan member.
review.schema.plan.cwd: Absolute worktree path. It must equal the CWD argument of the plan command.
review.schema.plan.cycles: Ignored. The command records each member's execution cycle.
review.schema.plan.plan_id: Plan ID. It starts with a lowercase letter or digit, then up to 63 more characters from [a-z0-9-].
review.schema.plan.recorded_at: Ignored. The command sets the UTC timestamp.
review.schema.plan.report_language: Report language. When omitted, the command uses each member card's LANGUAGE. Required when a member card has no LANGUAGE.
review.schema.plan.revision: Ignored on create. The command sets this to 1.
review.schema.plan.schema: Plan schema version. A new plan must use 1.
review.schema.plan.sealed: When true, every plan member must appear in a batch. False leaves the plan open for extend-plan.
review.schema.plan.task_ids: Member task IDs. The command sorts them and rejects duplicates. Every batch task ID must be in this list.
